content: And once the storm is over, you won't remember how you made it through. But one thing is certain: when you come out of the storm, you won't be the same person who walked in.
author: Haruki Murakami
story:
Preserved as part of Haruki Murakami's enduring intellectual legacy, this reflection addresses the fundamental nature of storm and resilience. Across his life and work, Haruki Murakami returned repeatedly to the conviction that personal integrity, honest observation, and clarity of purpose are the foundational pillars of a life well-lived.

Contemplating this truth invites us to step back from the frantic rush of daily demands. By examining our assumptions with fresh eyes, we discover the inner grounding necessary to act with wisdom and quiet conviction.
reflectionPrompt: When you look back on past hardships, how did navigating them expand your capacity for strength?
